title: Uruguayan Millet Dish
description: A hearty, citrusy dish from Uruguay featuring jagged millet and a flavorful pilaf.

ingredients.name: Pilaf
ingredients.notes: Cooked pilaf with onions and spices

ingredients.name: Citrusy Orange
ingredients.notes: Juice and zest for added flavor

instructions: 1. Cook the pilaf according to package instructions.
2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the Uruguayan chorizo and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned.
4. Add the millet to the skillet and stir to combine with the chorizo and oil.
5. Add the cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Squeeze the juice of the orange over the top of the millet mixture.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
